title: Gantt
summary: An in-house, virtualized Gantt chart drawn on canvas, fed by a query (a project, a program or a portfolio through descendantsOf), grouping tickets by project with summary bars and milestones, supporting drag-and-drop editing, finish-to-start dependencies with lag (including across projects), manual scheduling with violated dependencies shown in red, day/week/month/quarter scales, keyboard navigation and an equivalent table view. A rendering prototype starts in month 3 to de-risk the 5,000-row target. SS/FF/SF dependencies, automatic scheduling, critical path, baselines and exports are out of the MVP.

stories.title: Prototype the virtualized Gantt rendering
stories.i_want: a rendering prototype of the canvas Gantt with 5,000 rows, started in month 3
stories.so_that: we validate the rendering approach and performance before building the full feature
acceptance: Given a synthetic dataset of 5,000 rows and 2,000 dependencies, When I scroll vertically and horizontally, Then scrolling stays smooth (no frame above 16 ms on the reference machine for typical scrolls)
Given the prototype, When the viewport changes, Then only visible rows and visible time range are drawn
Given the light and dark themes, When the prototype renders, Then all colors come from `--mat-sys-*` and `--app-gantt-*` tokens
Given the prototype is reviewed, When the team decides, Then a short ADR records the rendering choice (canvas layers, hit testing, text rendering) and measured results

tech.title: Build the canvas rendering engine prototype
tech.description: In web/projects/ui, prototype a Gantt rendering engine: row virtualization, time-axis viewport, layered canvases (grid, bars, dependencies, overlay), device-pixel-ratio handling and token-based colors read from CSS custom properties at runtime. Keep the engine framework-agnostic behind an Angular component wrapper.
done_when: Unit tests cover viewport math (visible rows, date-to-pixel mapping for each scale)
Rendering works in light and dark themes without hard-coded colors

tech.title: Add a 5,000-row performance benchmark
tech.description: Create a synthetic data generator and an automated benchmark (Playwright with performance traces) measuring first render and scroll frame times for 5,000 rows, run in CI as a non-blocking report until the feature is complete, then as a gate.
done_when: Benchmark runs through a `just` recipe and publishes frame-time results
Results meet the smooth-scrolling target on the reference machine

tech.title: Record the Gantt rendering decision in an ADR
tech.description: Write an ADR in docs/ describing the chosen rendering architecture, hit-testing approach, accessibility layer strategy and benchmark results, with alternatives considered (SVG, DOM).
done_when: ADR reviewed and merged with the prototype

stories.title: View a multi-project Gantt from a query
stories.i_want: a Gantt chart fed by a query such as project IN descendantsOf("PROG-MODSI")
stories.so_that: I see the schedule of all projects of a program or portfolio in one view
acceptance: Given a program with three projects, When I open its Gantt, Then tickets are grouped by project with a summary bar per project
Given a project reached through two parents, When the Gantt loads, Then it appears only once
Given dated tickets and milestones, When the Gantt renders, Then tickets show as bars with progress fill and milestones as diamonds
Given the scale selector, When I switch between day, week, month and quarter, Then the time axis and bars update accordingly
Given tickets without dates, When the Gantt loads, Then they are listed in the table part without a bar
Given I edit the query, When I apply it, Then the Gantt reloads with the matching tickets and respects my permissions

tech.title: Expose a Gantt data endpoint
tech.description: Implement `POST /api/v1/gantt` taking a query (compiled by the L06 query language) and returning a compact payload: project groups with summary dates, rows (key, title, start, due, progress, assignee, milestone flag) and dependencies, with distinct projects and permission/RLS filtering. Progress uses status categories as for aggregates.
done_when: Unit tests for grouping and summary date computation
Integration tests on a real PostgreSQL cover descendantsOf queries, multi-parent de-duplication, confidential projects and tenant isolation
Benchmark: 5,000 rows returned under the read performance target

tech.title: Render project groups, bars, milestones and scales
tech.description: Extend the rendering engine with project summary rows, ticket bars with progress fill, milestone diamonds, today line, and day/week/month/quarter time headers. Dates are local planning dates, never converted through UTC.
done_when: Unit tests cover each scale's header generation and bar geometry
Visual regression snapshots for light and dark themes

tech.title: Build the Gantt screen with query and scale controls
tech.description: Assemble the Gantt page: query field with autocompletion (reusing the L06 editor), scale mat-button-toggle-group, synchronized table part (key, title, start, end, assignee) and canvas timeline, wired to the generated client via signals with loading, empty and error states.
done_when: Component unit tests and a screen integration test pass
axe check passes; Transloco keys only

stories.title: Reschedule tickets by drag and drop
stories.i_want: to move and resize bars with the mouse
stories.so_that: I can adjust the plan directly on the timeline
acceptance: Given a ticket bar, When I drag it by one week, Then its start and due dates move by one week and are saved
Given a ticket bar, When I resize its end, Then only the due date changes
Given the ticket was changed by someone else meanwhile, When I drop, Then the change is refused with a version conflict message and the bar returns to the server position
Given the ticket has assignments, When I move it, Then I am offered to shift its assignment segments by the same offset, and the overload check applies
Given I lack the edit permission on a ticket, When I try to drag it, Then the bar cannot be moved

tech.title: Add a reschedule endpoint with assignment shifting
tech.description: Implement `POST /api/v1/issues/{key}/reschedule` (new start/due, If-Match, option to shift assignment segments by the same offset in working or calendar days) in one transaction, applying the overload check from L08 and writing history entries.
done_when: Domain unit tests cover segment shifting across holidays, part-time days and DST change weeks
Integration tests on a real PostgreSQL cover version conflicts, overload rejection, permission denial and history

tech.title: Implement drag, resize and hit testing on the canvas
tech.description: Add pointer interactions to the engine: hit testing on bars and edges, drag to move, edge drag to resize, snapping to the current scale, ghost preview, and permission-aware disabled state. On drop, call the reschedule endpoint and roll back on error.
done_when: Unit tests cover hit testing, snapping and rollback
Screen integration test covers a successful move and a version conflict

tech.title: Offer to shift assignments after a move
tech.description: After a move on a ticket with assignments, show a dialog proposing to shift its assignments, with the overload result if any and the "Force overload" option for permitted roles.
done_when: Component unit tests and a screen integration test pass; axe check passes

stories.title: Manage finish-to-start dependencies with lag
stories.i_want: to create finish-to-start dependencies with positive or negative lag, including across projects, and see violations
stories.so_that: I keep the schedule consistent while scheduling manually
acceptance: Given two tickets, When I drag from the end of the first to the second, Then a finish-to-start dependency is created and drawn as an arrow
Given a dependency with a lag of +2 days, When the successor starts before the predecessor's end plus 2 working days, Then the dependency is shown in red and an alert lists it
Given a dependency with negative lag, When the successor starts within the allowed overlap, Then it is not flagged
Given tickets in different projects, When I create a dependency between them, Then it is accepted and shown in the multi-project Gantt
Given a dependency that would create a cycle, When I try to create it, Then it is rejected with a stable Problem Details code
Given I move a predecessor later, When the dependency becomes violated, Then nothing is moved automatically and the violation is shown

tech.title: Implement dependency rules in the domain crate
tech.description: In crates/domain, model finish-to-start dependencies with a lag in working days, detect violations given ticket dates and calendars, and detect cycles. Manual scheduling only: no automatic date propagation.
done_when: Unit tests cover positive and negative lag, holidays inside the lag, cross-project dependencies and cycle detection
Property-based tests check cycle detection on random graphs

tech.title: Store dependencies and expose dependency endpoints
tech.description: Store finish-to-start dependencies with lag (extend `issue_link` with a lag column for the "blocks/depends on" link type, or a dedicated table per the agreed model) with RLS, and implement create/delete endpoints plus violation computation returned with the Gantt payload.
done_when: Migration applies cleanly
Integration tests on a real PostgreSQL cover create, delete, cycle rejection, cross-project links, permissions and tenant isolation

tech.title: Draw dependencies and create them with the mouse
tech.description: Draw dependency arrows with routing on the canvas, red rendering for violated ones (token-based), a violation banner listing them, and a drag-from-bar-end interaction to create a dependency with a lag dialog.
done_when: Unit tests cover arrow routing and violation styling
Screen integration test covers creation and the violation banner; violations are conveyed by text too

stories.title: Use the Gantt with the keyboard and a table view
stories.i_want: to navigate, read and edit the Gantt without a mouse, and to switch to an equivalent table view
stories.so_that: the Gantt meets RGAA 4 / WCAG 2.1 AA
acceptance: Given focus is in the Gantt, When I press arrow keys, Then focus moves between rows and the focused row is announced with key, title, dates and assignee
Given a focused ticket, When I use the documented shortcuts, Then I can move it or change its dates by one unit of the current scale
Given a focused ticket, When I open its dependencies menu, Then I can add or remove a finish-to-start dependency without the mouse
Given I click "Show as table", When the table view opens, Then it lists the same rows, dates, dependencies and violations in an accessible mat-table with virtual scrolling
Given focus is visible, When I navigate, Then the focus indicator uses the theme tokens and meets contrast requirements

tech.title: Add the keyboard and screen reader layer over the canvas
tech.description: Implement an accessible grid layer (roving tabindex on virtualized DOM rows, ARIA grid roles, live region for announcements) synchronized with the canvas, with keyboard shortcuts for navigation, moving, resizing and dependency management.
done_when: Unit tests cover keyboard handling and announcements
Screen integration test performs a move and a dependency creation with the keyboard only
axe check passes

tech.title: Build the equivalent table view
tech.description: Add the "Show as table" view: mat-table with cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport listing project groups, tickets, dates, assignees, dependencies and violations, with inline date editing using the same reschedule endpoint.
done_when: Component unit tests and a screen integration test pass
Table view handles 5,000 rows with virtual scrolling; axe check passes

stories.title: See other users' changes live on the Gantt
stories.i_want: the Gantt to update when another user changes dates, dependencies or tickets in view
stories.so_that: I always plan on current data
acceptance: Given two users view the same Gantt, When one moves a bar, Then the other sees the bar move within a few seconds without reloading
Given a ticket matching my query is created elsewhere, When the event arrives, Then it appears in the Gantt
Given I am dragging a bar, When a remote change on the same ticket arrives, Then my drop is checked against the new version and conflicts are reported

tech.title: Subscribe the Gantt to real-time ticket events
tech.description: Use the L05 real-time stream (SSE) to apply ticket date, dependency, creation and deletion events to the Gantt store incrementally, re-rendering only affected rows, and re-evaluating violations.
done_when: Unit tests cover event application to the store
Screen integration test with a simulated event stream passes

tech.title: Publish dependency events and filter by Gantt scope
tech.description: Emit outbox events for dependency changes and reschedules, and let the real-time endpoint filter events by the projects in the subscriber's Gantt scope with permission checks.
done_when: Unit tests for scope filtering
Integration tests on a real PostgreSQL and Valkey cover event emission, filtering and permission checks across two API instances

tech.title: Test the Gantt flow end to end
tech.description: Playwright scenarios: open a program Gantt, switch scales, move a bar and shift its assignments, create a dependency and see the violation, navigate and edit with the keyboard, open the table view, and observe a change made in a second browser context.
done_when: Scenarios pass in CI through the `just` e2e recipe
axe checks pass on the Gantt and table views
